match.userMessage: One greyscale storyboard frame. Frozen in this action: Scarlett walks against the flow as a gust catches her scarf and she grabs it. Framing: medium wide, eye level, Scarlett moves through the crosswalk on the center third, taxis and office towers layered behind her, phone raised and coffee held in the foreground. Placement only, not the pose: Scarlett has just stepped into the crowded crosswalk, filming herself with one hand while keeping her coffee level with the other. Camera, as one or two arrows: handheld truck, smooth. Characters: Scarlett, Woman, 27, A 27-year-old woman of average height, Black fitted turtleneck, black wool coat carried. The bodies are frozen in that action: if someone sits, they are seated; if someone reaches, the arm is extended. One figure per character. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Camera travel is one or two arrows. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
